thread:
Maria L.: Quick idea — for the AB dashboard can we add derivative/regression signals instead of only raw rates? e.g. d(error_rate)/dt and normalized delta vs control. would help detect slow leaks.

Aj Patel: +1. We need to define the telemetry contract though. Which raw metrics do you want as inputs? p95, qps, error_rate, tokens?

Maria L.: Inputs: per-route `request_count`, `error_count`, `latency_p95`, `cpu_util`, and `tokens_generated`. Derived: `error_rate`, `delta_error_rate`, `relative_p95_change`.

Samir K.: note: runtime batching and KV cache will make `tokens_generated` noisy. propose adding `effective_batch_size` and `kv_hit_ratio` so math doesn't mislead.

Priya N.: From product POV, alerts should map to rollback playbook. can we map severity tiers (info/warn/critical) to suggested actions (canary increase, rollback)?

Luca D.: I'll own the dashboard queries. need exact metric names + tags (route/model/variant). prefer tag `variant=canary|control` and `route=/chat/`.

Ruth I.: infra wants sample rate exported. if sampling changes mid-rollout comparisons break. include `sampling_rate` in the panel and make it visible as a small subtitle.

deploy-bot: deploy event: rollout/ab-exp-2026-03-18 started by @maria — canary=10% control=90% commit=ab12f9

Aj Patel: For contract: let's standardize metric names: `redwood.requests.count`, `redwood.requests.errors`, `redwood.latency.p95`, `redwood.runtime.batch_size`, `redwood.runtime.kv_hit_ratio`, `redwood.tokens.generated`, `redwood.telemetry.sampling_rate`. All tagged by `{route, model, variant, region}`.

Samir K.: Also expose `avg_inflight_requests` and `queue_latency_ms` for contention signals.

Maria L.: UX ask: show small per-slice sparklines + delta heatmap. critical to have a compare-mode where canary vs control lines overlay with shaded CI.

Priya N.: +emoji :thumbsup: Can we have thresholds editable in the UI and stored per-experiment? product wants to tweak without infra intervening.

Aj Patel: Backend: we can implement adjustable thresholds stored in `rollout_config` service. API endpoints: `GET /v1/experiments/:id/thresholds` `PUT /v1/experiments/:id/thresholds`.

Luca D.: Query cost caveat: computing derivatives for many slices is expensive. propose we precompute `delta_window` as a rollup metric with 1m and 5m windows.

Ruth I.: Agree. Can we have a quota guard: if dashboard query cost > X tokens/min we'll fall back to sampled view. Add `query_cost_estimate` metric.

Maria L.: Action items: 1) Aj to draft telemetry contract PR with metric names/tags + API outline. 2) Samir to add `batch_size` + `kv_hit_ratio` telemetry. 3) Luca to prototype queries and heatmap. 4) Priya to draft alert-to-action mapping docs. 5) Ruth to add sampling_rate monitor and query_cost metric.

Aj Patel: I'll open the PR today and ping infra/reliability for review. tagging @Ruth I. and @Samir K.

Samir K.: I'll push runtime changes behind a feature flag. expect telemetry in prod in ~3 days.

Luca D.: I'll sketch the dashboard panels tomorrow. will post panel wireframe here.

Priya N.: ordering: alerts -> rollbacks -> UI thresholds. will coordinate the playbook doc.

Maria L.: thanks all. keeping this thread as the single source for sync. if no objections I'll create a short RFC with the spec.

Aj Patel: no objections. :white_check_mark:

Luca D.: wireframe posted: https://internal.design/rollout-heatmap (preview)

Maria L.: plan: RFC + PR + dashboard prototype. owner: Maria L. ETA: RFC by Fri, dashboards proto next week.

Priya N.: noted. tagging support to prepare runbook.

Ruth I.: added `sampling_rate` metric to backlog. will update ETA after capacity check.

Maria L.: cool. closing for now — will post RFC link here when ready.
